concepts.simple_definition: 9 Text Book Page Periodization in African history is unique from the rest of the world as a result of Europe- an colonization
concepts.deep_explanation: The civilization developed by African peoples was disrupted as a result of their contacts with Europeans beginning from the 15th century AD
